svg.title: Compilation scaling: historical comparison-specialization reduction
svg.desc: Three zero-based bar panels compare before and after PR 792. Method instances fall from 962 to 62; LLVM IR lines from 197808 to 26898; AOT build time from 32.4 to 1.9 seconds. Each panel has different units and its own scale. Source revisions are 554f3d1 and 570eb4e. These are historical report measurements, not current-main timings. Frontend class-pair analysis remains and no execution-speed conclusion is drawn.
svg.title: Historical comparison-specialization reduction

ns2:Work.dc:title: Historical comparison-specialization reduction
ns2:Work.dc:description: PR #792, 554f3d1 to 570eb4e: ordinary class with other: object, 30 subclasses and 40 comparison sites. Method instances 962 to 62; LLVM IR lines 197808 to 26898; one-CPU AOT build 32.4 to 1.9 seconds, LLVM 18.1.3. Different axes and units. No new timing, runtime-speed or whole-compiler scaling claim.
